regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Cypress Mountain is forecast for about 49". Whistler follows.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Palisades is forecast for about 33". Sugar Bowl and Kirkwood follow. Winter Storm Warning at Palisades from Friday.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Crystal Mountain is forecast for about 29", 17" of it Tuesday. Mt. Baker and Stevens Pass follow.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Snowbasin is forecast for about 23", 14" of it Friday. Powder Mountain and Brighton follow. Winter Storm Warning at Snowbasin from Thursday night to Saturday.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 25". Jackson Hole and Big Sky follow. Winter Weather Advisory at Grand Targhee from Thursday night to Friday night.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride is forecast for about 9". Aspen Highlands and Crested Butte follow.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 6", 3" of it Saturday. Taos follows.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 11, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Nov 22–28. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
